newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill cuts Cone Mills.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill cuts Cone Mills.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it cut its rating of Cone Mills Corp to near-term neutral from accumulate.
-- Merrill said it kept Cone Mill's long-term rating at accumulate.
-- Merrill Lynch analyst Pamela Singleton said she does not expect Cone Mills's stock to outperform the market over the near term.
-- Merrill said Cone Mills's period of operating weakness may be longer than previously expected.
-- Cone Mills's fourth quarter results are being hurt by cutbacks in both the apparel and home furnishings segments, Merrill said.
-- Cone Mills's fourth quarter revenues are expected to drop about 25 percent to $165 million, Merrill said.

-- Merrill expects Cone Mills to post a fourth quarter loss from operations of about $0.29 a share. The company should post a loss from operations of $0.15 a share for the full year, on revenues of $753 million, Merrill said.
-- Merrill sees Cone Mills's 1997 revenues at about $800 million.
